domains.result: The root page (http:// and https://, with and without www) is a small GoDaddy parking stub whose script sends the browser to /lander, which serves GoDaddy's parking-lander page (window.LANDER_SYSTEM="PW", assets from img1.wsimg.com/parking-lander); that ends on a third-party article page at dot-services.org which returns an Akamai 'Access Denied' error (title 'Access Denied', reference #18.be85d817.1794604722.71725fd, errors.edgesuite.net). Same outcome in a desktop browser window (screenshot 800 px wide) and at 390 px phone width (screenshot 390 px wide). likely_cause.reasoning: The public registry record shows the registration current (expiry 2027-08-06, last changed 2022-09-12, registrar GoDaddy, client delete/renew/transfer/update holds in place) and a creation date of 2008, so the name does not look lost or re-registered by a stranger. It sits on GoDaddy nameservers (NS21/NS22.DOMAINCONTROL.COM) and the page served is GoDaddy's own parking lander. Wayback shows the real GoDaddy Website Builder site still live on 13 Nov 2025 and the same parking-lander stub by 17 Jul 2026, so the website or hosting plan attached to the domain appears to have been taken down or lapsed while the domain stayed registered. Recorded as inference: no source states why.

fix_steps.step: Log in to the GoDaddy account that holds molnarroofinginc.com and check two separate things: the domain registration (current, registered through 6 August 2027 on the public registry record) and any website builder or hosting plan on it. Restore or renew the website plan, or point the domain at new hosting. Keep the domain on auto-renew with a billing email someone reads.
fix_steps.who: Owner, with whoever set the site up on the phone

fix_steps.step: Publish a simple one-page site on the domain: what they do (roof replacement, repair, slate, flat roofs, gutters, siding), service area, phone, hours, a few job photos and the licence number. Use the archived copy of the old site as a reference for their own wording, or write fresh copy.

Update the Google Business Profile: replace or confirm the website link, add hours (the profile currently shows 'Add hours'), add services and photos, confirm the service area. Google verifies some edits, so allow a few days.
fix_steps.who: Owner (profile owner) or web person given access

fix_steps.step: Claim or correct the other listings that repeat the old details and link: the CLAD Siding listing links molnarroofinginc.com, and the Birdeye profile (4.8 from 5 reviews) states it has not been claimed by the business. Correct the website field once the new site is live.
Add a simple check that warns them if the domain or site stops responding (an uptime monitor plus a calendar reminder before each renewal), and retest the Google website link afterwards on a phone.

after_fix.opportunity: Add a short quote-request form (name, address, what is wrong with the roof, optional photo) so a homeowner can ask for an estimate outside working hours, with the form sending to an email address the owner reads.
after_fix.evidence: The Google profile shows a phone number and street address and nothing to fill in, and the Birdeye profile shows business hours but no appointment or quote request; no form on any listing I could read, so a homeowner with a leak after hours has phone only.

severity_reason: The website link on the Google profile leads to a parking stub and then a third-party 'Access Denied' page, and there is no working site carrying the business's services, hours or photos, so a homeowner has nothing to read and must call.

# Website Health Check: Molnar Roofing Inc.

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**

- molnarroofinginc.com, the website on their Google profile, no longer shows their site: the address returns a GoDaddy parking stub that loads GoDaddy's parking lander, which sends visitors to a third-party article page that returns "Access Denied".
- Same in a desktop browser window and at 390 px phone width (screenshots shot-desktop-molnarroofinginc.png, shot-mobile390-molnarroofinginc.png). No certificate warning appeared, so the domain's HTTPS is not the failure.
- The Google profile still lists that domain, with 513 3rd Ave, North Brunswick Township, NJ 08902, (732) 846-0466, a 5.0 rating and "Add hours".
- An archived copy shows their real site live on 13 November 2025; the next capture, 17 July 2026, is the parking stub.

**What it means for customers**

A homeowner who taps "website" on the Google profile reaches an error page with no services, photos or quote route. The phone number on that profile works.

**How to fix it**

1. In the GoDaddy account, confirm the domain (registered through 6 August 2027) and check whether a hosting plan is still attached, then restore or renew it. Owner, with whoever built the site: 0.5-1.5 h.
2. Put a one-page site back: services (slate, repairs, flat roofs, gutters, siding), service area, phone, hours, photos. Web person: 3-6 h.
3. Update the Google profile: website link, hours, services, photos. Owner or web person: 0.5-1 h.
4. Correct the listings that copy the link (CLAD Siding) and claim the unclaimed Birdeye profile. Web person: 1-2 h.
5. Add an uptime check and renewal reminders, then retest the Google link on a phone. Web person: 0.5-1 h.

**After the fix**

Add a short quote-request form so a homeowner can ask for an estimate in writing; today the listings offer a phone number only.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.

# Founder notes: Molnar Roofing Inc. (B00875)

**Check before any outreach.** A public bankruptcy-record site lists a Chapter 7 petition filed 31 July 2026 by "Molnar Roofing, Inc." in the US Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, case 26-18658 (https://whofiledbankruptcy.com/case/njb/26-18658/). That page prints no debtor address, and PACER and CourtListener could not be opened from here, so I could not confirm whether the debtor is this 513 3rd Ave company. What I could check: the NJ business-name register returns one "Molnar Roofing, Inc." (entity 0100746999, North Brunswick, formed 27 May 1998), and the NJ Division of Consumer Affairs record for that entity shows 513 3rd Ave and an active home improvement business licence (13VH00774800, expires 31 March 2027, "accurate as of November 13, 2026"). Settle the docket question, or ask whoever answers the phone, before sending anything; if the debtor is this company, do not contact.

**Outreach email draft**

Subject: The website link on your Google listing shows an error

Hello,

I looked up Molnar Roofing on Google today and the website link on your listing goes through a GoDaddy parking page to an "Access Denied" screen, so anyone checking you out sees nothing about your roofing work. The domain itself is still registered through August 2027 with GoDaddy, which points to the website or hosting attached to it rather than a lost domain. I have screenshots of what a customer sees on a desktop and on a phone and can show you them, along with the handful of steps that would put a page back on that address - would a short call or a visit to 513 3rd Ave suit you?

**Walk-in / phone opener**

Hello, I am local - the website link on your Google listing currently lands on an error page, and I have phone screenshots of it if you want to see them.

**Sources**

- Live domain test, desktop and 390 px (screenshots shot-desktop-molnarroofinginc.png, shot-mobile390-molnarroofinginc.png): https://molnarroofinginc.com/ - http://, https:// and the www host all serve the same stub that loads /lander
- GoDaddy parking lander markup served on the live domain: https://molnarroofinginc.com/lander
- Google Business Profile with the website link, address, phone, 5.0 rating and "Add hours": https://www.google.com/maps/place/Molnar+Roofing+Inc/@40.4683503,-74.4479622,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x89c3c67c201ffef9:0x358a52857264f48!8m2!3d40.4683503!4d-74.4479622!16s%2Fg%2F1tdrg9f9
- RDAP registration record (registered 2008-08-06, expires 2027-08-06, last changed 2022-09-12, GoDaddy, GoDaddy nameservers, client holds): https://rdap.org/domain/molnarroofinginc.com
- Archived site live on 13 Nov 2025: https://web.archive.org/web/20251113060336/https://www.molnarroofinginc.com/
- Archived parking stub on the domain, 17 Jul 2026: https://web.archive.org/web/20260717115842/https://molnarroofinginc.com/
- Wayback index for the domain (dates and status codes): http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=molnarroofinginc.com&output=json
- CLAD Siding listing with molnarroofinginc.com, 513 3rd Ave and (732) 846-0466: https://www.cladsiding.com/contractors/new-jersey/north-brunswick-township/molnar-roofing-inc/
- Birdeye profile, stated as not claimed, 4.8 from 5 reviews, hours: https://reviews.birdeye.com/molnar-roofing-inc-165459006575678

**Open questions**

- Is the Chapter 7 case 26-18658 debtor this same company? The third-party page has no address and the docket could not be opened; only the owner, the court record or the trustee can settle it.
- Who holds the GoDaddy login for the domain, and is a website or hosting plan still attached to it?
- Is the person who answers (732) 846-0466 the owner of record on the state licence, and what name do they want used? The name "Steve" appears only in a December 2019 customer review, so it is not confirmed as the current owner.
- Did they stop the site on purpose, and do they want a site again or only the Google listing?
- Is the business taking new work? I found no review newer than 2019 on any listing I could open.
